Khoury et al, 2026 (bioRxiv): Single-cell proteomics reveals cell-type-specific functional coordination in PBMCs

khoury2026.Rd

Single-cell samples were prepared using the nPOP glass-slide sample preparation method and multiplexed with 2-plexDIA (mTRAQ). Proteomics data were acquired with slice-PASEF on timsTOF Ultra, timsTOF Ultra 2 and timsUltra AIP mass spectrometers. The dataset contains quantitative information on 1,651 single peripheral blood mononuclear cells (monocytes, NK cells, CD8 T cells, CD4 T cells and B cells) from two healthy donors. The data are available at the PSM, peptide and protein levels.

The paper investigates within-cell-type protein covariation (protein complex coordination, protein stability, functional rewiring between cell types and cytokine covariation) using matching single-cell RNA sequencing (Smart-seq3xpress) data from the same donors.

Format

A QFeatures object with 1103 assays, each assay being a SingleCellExperiment object:

  • Assay 1-1097: DIA-NN main output report table. Each run acquires 1 or 2 single cells. It contains the results of the spectrum identification and quantification.

  • Peptide_Normalized_Centered: peptide data containing quantitative data for 23,572 peptides and 1,651 single-cells. Values are column normalized and centered, so they are relative.

  • Peptide_Column_Normalized: peptide data containing quantitative data for 23,572 peptides and 1,651 single-cells. Values are column normalized and log transformed, so they are absolute values.

  • Protein_Imputed_Column_Normalized: protein data containing quantitative data for 3,732 proteins and 1,651 single-cells with k-nearest neighbors (KNN) imputation and comBat batch-correction.

  • Protein_Imputed_Normalized_Centered: protein data containing quantitative data for 3,732 proteins and 1,651 single-cells with k-nearest neighbors (KNN) imputation and comBat batch-correction.

  • Protein_Normalized_Centered: protein data containing quantitative data for 3,732 proteins and 1,651 single-cells.

  • Protein_Column_Normalized: protein data containing quantitative data for 3,732 proteins and 1,651 single-cells.

The colData(khoury2026()) contains cell type and batch annotations that are common to all assays.

Source

The data were downloaded from the Slavov Lab website via a shared Zenodo folder folder.

The data used and generated as part of the scpdata repackaging is available in the Zenodo archive.

Acquisition protocol

The data were acquired using the following setup. More information can be found in the source article (see References).

  • Cell isolation: CellenONE cell sorting.

  • Sample preparation performed using the nPOP sample preparation method. cell lysis (DMSO) + trypsin digestion + mTRAQ labelling (d0/d4) + pooling with an mTRAQ d8-labelled isotopologous carrier (5 cell-equivalents).

  • Separation: online nLC (NanoElute2, UltiMate 3000 or Vanquish Neo HPLC) with a 25cm x 75um IonOpticks Aurora column; 30 min active gradient (4-40% buffer B) at 200 nL/min.

  • Mass spectrometry: timsTOF Ultra, timsTOF Ultra 2, and timsUltra AIP mass spectrometers.

  • Data analysis: DIA-NN (v1.8.2 beta 17).

Data collection

The data were collected from a Zenodo folder that is accessible from the SlavovLab website (see Source section).

The folder ('Batch_IDs_and_abundances/') contains the following files of interest:

  • IdentificationsList_n2p1.csv: PSM level processed quantitative data.

  • IdentificationsList_n2p2.csv: PSM level processed quantitative data.

  • IdentificationsList_n3p1.csv: PSM level processed quantitative data.

  • IdentificationsList_n6p1.csv: PSM level processed quantitative data.

  • IdentificationsList_n6p2.csv: PSM level processed quantitative data.

Following files of interest also available in Zenodo:

  • Peptide_x_Cell_Matrix_Normalized_Centered.csv: peptide level processed quantitative data.

  • Peptide_x_Cell_Matrix_Column_Normalized.csv: peptide level processed quantitative data.

  • Protein_x_Cell_Matrix_Imputed_Column_Normalized.csv: protein level processed quantitative data.

  • Protein_x_Cell_Matrix_Imputed_Normalized_Centered.csv: protein level processed quantitative data.

  • Protein_x_Cell_Matrix_Normalized_Centered.csv: protein level processed quantitative data.

  • Protein_x_Cell_Matrix_Column_Normalized.csv: protein level processed quantitative data.

  • PBMC_covariation_protein_cell_metadata.csv: Sample metadata.

  • PepProtMap_integrated.csv: Peptide to Protein mapping.

We formatted the PSM level quantification tables so that columns match with those of the annotation and peptide/protein level data. Each PSM level data turned into SingleCellExperiment objects including row data information. All the PSM level assays used to generate QFeatures object.

The peptide and protein assays were formatted as SingleCellExperiment objects and the sample metadata were matched to the column names. The objects are then added to the QFeatures object and the rows of the PSM data are linked to the rows of the corresponding peptide data based on the sequence information through an AssayLink object. Peptide assays and protein assays linked in the same way through Gene Symbols as provided by the authors.

References

Khoury L, et al., Single-cell proteomics reveals cell-type-specific functional coordination in PBMCs, bioRxiv, doi: 10.64898/2026.09.11.751068 (link to article).
